title: Emergency Arresting Tailhook
summary: Retractable ventral emergency arresting hook stowed flush between the aft engine nacelles for runway cable engagement.
role: Provides emergency runway arresting capability during brake failure or aborted takeoff.
materials: Forged high-strength steel shank with flush stealth door.
